data.body:
## Independent adversarial validation

An independent subagent reviewed the frozen evidence, draft claims, denominators, and proposed recommendations. It labeled the defect-measurement gap VALIDATED. Every other material finding was QUALIFIED rather than rejected: the observed pattern is real, but causal interpretation is limited by the 68-day window, partial Q3, process changes during the window, author/bot-supplied metadata, or proxy quality. No major finding was rejected.

Corrections prompted by rechecking: exact median cycle time is 0.06341 days = 1.52 hours, not the rounded 1.44 hours in the preliminary evidence comment. Frozen-ref bug close classes are 242 preexisting, 42 plan_defect, 39 regression, 37 env_integration, 17 flaky, 39 duplicate, 22 not_a_bug, 2 undetermined, and 208 unclassified; the preliminary comment incorrectly reported 40 regression and 207 missing. The strict Testing-heading completion cohort is 267/335 = 79.7% first-pass versus 455/663 = 68.6%; declared file impact is 74.2% versus 67.6% undeclared.

Reviewer calibration by finding:
- QUALIFIED — Throughput is high and median cycle time is short, but neither establishes sustainable flow or quality; commit counts are not person-hours.
- QUALIFIED — Plan-review adoption rose materially. Review-before-claim includes 29 claims preceded only by a non-PASS review; the stricter PASS-before-claim counts are Q2 135/465 and Q3 1,127/1,452. First-pass plan review is 49.0% and p90 attempts is 8, but the 116,560-call ratio is mixed-cohort operational load, not a clean unit-cost measure.
- QUALIFIED — Completion first-pass is 72.3%. Testing headings and file-impact declarations correlate with better first-pass results, but headings are a textual proxy and failures include evidence, environment, and verifier errors as well as code defects.
- QUALIFIED — Code-review first-pass is 97.4%; this describes the observed funnel, not reviewer effectiveness or escaped-defect prevention. The similar rate for caused_by sources only shows weak discrimination against noisy blame attribution.
- VALIDATED — No current bug has detected_by metadata, so true escape rate and detection-stage efficiency are unavailable. caused_by links are advisory and demonstrably noisy; they are not ground truth. Larger diffs and initial plan non-PASS are candidate prospective risk signals only.
- QUALIFIED — Source diffs became smaller and test co-change increased from Q2 to partial Q3, while ticket/DCO/Change-Id hygiene reached effectively complete August adoption. This supports process maturation, not a proven quality improvement.
- QUALIFIED — The 35 modules at or above 720 LOC, 15 at or above 780, and 4.09% duplication identify debt pressure. Same-file retouch is a hotspot/coordination proxy, not proven rework.
- QUALIFIED — OSS governance artifacts and release tags are strong. Top operator/bot authorship accounts for 92.4% of commits, establishing authorship concentration but not absence of independent human review; Gerrit reviewer/vote history was not analyzed.

Claims intentionally excluded: process adoption proves fewer defects; caused_by is accurate attribution; high code-review PASS proves high review quality; Testing headings or file retouch are quality objectives; and more ceremony should be applied uniformly.
